scope: Authored complete-example outputs checked against explicit effective bases. CWT and project validation are static checks, not an in-game launch or save/load test.
limitations: Supplied corpus versions are not identified by the downloaded upstream descriptor.
The supplied snapshots omit proprietary art; original example flags, portraits and UI textures are included.
Kaiserreich's missing map text is supplemented from the pinned public commit; binaries remain inherited from the installed game and are not validated here.

kaiserreichDescriptor.purpose: Explicit load-order metadata for validation of the supplied stripped Kaiserreich text snapshot. The snapshot does not include its own descriptor or map directory. This fetched descriptor is recorded separately and does not modify or identify the snapshot version.
